verdict.rationale: Crossmint is API-first: wallets run through 'a single API', checkout has a headless REST API with 'full control of the user experience' as an alternative to the embedded iframe UI, and onramp and offramp orders are created through documented API endpoints. Nothing in the evidence states or shows that every UI or console capability has an API equivalent, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. missing for 10: explicit UI/console-to-API parity statement, evidence that dashboard/console operations (project, key and policy management) are API-accessible, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Crossmint's headless checkout API is a set of REST APIs that allow you to integrate credit card and cross-chain crypto payments inside your app with full control of the user experience.
Crossmint offers secure, programmable smart wallet infrastructure through a single API that is configurable for any use case
handle every wallet operation, including creation, transaction execution, gas sponsorship, onramps, compliance, and advanced policies, so you can launch in minutes
Creates an onramp order to buy tokens with a card.
